192 bytes ($0640-$06FF) after the 64 cells of the strip that are filled in, all zero. Scene 18's header byte $0705 is 0, so the position mask $5E is $FF (set at $565C from $59A1). The map is 256 cells long, and these bytes are its cells 64 to 255, all empty.

Start of the 32-byte scene header that the loader at $557A unpacks after the map. The bytes are $50 49 2D 2D 01 00 00 00 09 0B 0F 0F 0F 0F 55 49. The loader reads $0701 ($49, "I") as the name character of the picture P and character set C resources it loads to $BC00 and $E000, $070F ($49, "I") as the name character of the overlay U loaded to $8B00, and $0703 ($2D, "-") as the extra costume selector, where a dash means none. $0700 and $0702 are not read by the loader.

Three numeric header bytes: $0704 (1) is the loop limit the loader compares at $568F and is read by the camera and motion routines ($287C, $3447, $4409, $48C6); the resident also stores to it at $6B9E. $0705 (0) indexes the tables at $59A1 and $59A8 that set $5E, $5F and $60 ($FF and $00 here), and from $566A $0706 (0) is shifted right twice into $02C8 (0), its low two bits going to bits 7-6 of $02C7.

Seven colour bytes ($0707-$070D = 00 09 0B 0F 0F 0F 0F) read by $5A34: $0708 and $0709 go to the VIC background colour registers $D022 and $D023, $0707 is cached at $02DD as the display colour, and $070A-$070D are copied to the four message palette bytes $6998-$699B unless $0387 and $26 are both negative ($5A46-$5A4D then skip to $5A6D).
Two bytes, "UI" ($55 $49): the overlay resource name, whose second character the loader compares with its cache at $508E and loads at $8B00 ($070F).
